description: Screened-Coulomb electrostatic potential above the concave and convex faces of amphiphysin (control), ACAP1 and ACAP3 BAR dimers
code:
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T',
 'TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
CHG={('LYS','NZ'):1.0,('ARG','CZ'):1.0,('ASP','CG'):-1.0,('GLU','CD'):-1.0,('HIS','NE2'):0.1}
def read_full(fn,chain=None,lo=None,hi=None):
    at=[]
    for l in open(fn):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        c=l[21]; num=int(l[22:26])
        if chain and c!=chain: continue
        if lo is not None and not(lo<=num<=hi): continue
        at.append((rn,l[12:16].strip(),c,num,np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return at
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc));D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc

# rebuild full-atom dimers
def biomt_dimer(fn,chain):
    cur={}
    for l in open(fn):
        if l.startswith("REMARK 350   BIOMT"):
            k=int(l[18]); cur.setdefault(k,[]).append([float(x) for x in l[24:].split()])
    out=[]
    mono=read_full(fn,chain=chain)
    for i in range(len(cur[1])):
        M=np.array([cur[1][i][:3],cur[2][i][:3],cur[3][i][:3]])
        T=np.array([cur[1][i][3],cur[2][i][3],cur[3][i][3]])
        for rn,nm,c,num,x in mono: out.append((rn,nm,"AB"[i],num,M@x+T))
    return out
amph=biomt_dimer("1URU.pdb","A")
acap1=read_full("4NSW.pdb",chain="A",lo=1,hi=230)+read_full("4NSW.pdb",chain="B",lo=1,hi=230)
# ACAP3 dimer: reuse the superposition (recompute via CA Kabsch on the cached pairs is unavailable,
# so superpose ACAP3 BAR CA onto ACAP1 chain A CA by the structural pairs recomputed with simple numbering-free DP is costly;
# instead use the saved CA coordinates of the model to derive the transform)
Z=np.load("bar_models.npz")
a3ca_model=Z['acap3_ca']            # already in 4NSW frame (A then B copies)
a3_src=read_full("AF_ACAP3.pdb",chain="A",lo=1,hi=230)
srcCA=np.array([x for rn,nm,c,num,x in a3_src if nm=="CA"])
n=len(srcCA)
acap3=[]
for i,cid in enumerate(("A","B")):
    R,t=kabsch(srcCA,a3ca_model[i*n:(i+1)*n])
    rms=np.sqrt((((R@srcCA.T).T+t-a3ca_model[i*n:(i+1)*n])**2).sum(1).mean())
    assert rms<0.1, rms
    for rn,nm,c,num,x in a3_src: acap3.append((rn,nm,cid,num,R@x+t))

def potential_profile(atoms,label):
    X=np.array([a[4] for a in atoms])
    Qp=[];Qx=[]
    for rn,nm,c,num,x in atoms:
        if (rn,nm) in CHG: Qp.append(CHG[(rn,nm)]); Qx.append(x)
    Qp=np.array(Qp); Qx=np.array(Qx)
    CA=np.array([a[4] for a in atoms if a[1]=="CA"])
    C=CA.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(CA-C,full_matrices=False)
    pc=(CA-C)@Vt.T
    k=sorted([(abs(np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,j],2)[0]),j) for j in (1,2)])[-1][1]
    co=np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,k],2); a=co[0]
    j3=({1,2}-{k}).pop()
    # probe grid: points along the long axis, offset 6 A beyond the protein surface on concave / convex sides
    xs=np.linspace(np.percentile(pc[:,0],5),np.percentile(pc[:,0],95),40)
    zs=np.linspace(np.percentile(pc[:,j3],15),np.percentile(pc[:,j3],85),9)
    res={}
    for side,sgn in (("concave",-np.sign(a)),("convex",np.sign(a))):
        pts=[]
        for xv in xs:
            yline=np.polyval(co,xv)
            near=np.abs(pc[:,0]-xv)<6
            if near.sum()<3: continue
            # protein extent on this side at this x
            edge=(pc[near,k]-yline)
            lim=(edge.max() if sgn>0 else edge.min())
            for zv in zs:
                p=np.zeros(3); p[0]=xv; p[k]=yline+lim+sgn*6.0; p[j3]=zv
                pts.append(C+Vt.T@p)
        pts=np.array(pts)
        # drop probes that clash with protein
        d=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
        pts=pts[d>4.0]
        D=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-Qx[None,:,:],axis=2)
        lam=8.0   # Debye length, 150 mM monovalent
        phi=(332.0/78.0)*np.sum(Qp[None,:]*np.exp(-D/lam)/D,axis=1)   # kcal/mol/e
        res[side]=(float(np.mean(phi)),float(np.median(phi)),len(pts))
    print(f"{label:<34} concave <phi>={res['concave'][0]:+7.3f}  convex <phi>={res['convex'][0]:+7.3f}  "
          f"difference={res['concave'][0]-res['convex'][0]:+7.3f} kcal/mol/e  (n probes {res['concave'][2]}/{res['convex'][2]})")
    return res

print("Screened-Coulomb potential 6 A above the BAR surface (eps=78, Debye length 8 A):")
r_amph=potential_profile(amph,"Amphiphysin BAR (1URU) CONTROL")
r_a1  =potential_profile(acap1,"ACAP1 BAR (4NSW crystal)")
r_a3  =potential_profile(acap3,"ACAP3 BAR (AlphaFold on 4NSW)")
json.dump({"amphiphysin":r_amph,"ACAP1":r_a1,"ACAP3":r_a3},open("bar_electrostatics.json","w"),indent=1)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.4))
names=["Amphiphysin\n(1URU, control)","ACAP1 BAR\n(4NSW)","ACAP3 BAR\n(AlphaFold)"]
conc=[r_amph['concave'][0],r_a1['concave'][0],r_a3['concave'][0]]
conv=[r_amph['convex'][0],r_a1['convex'][0],r_a3['convex'][0]]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,conc,w,label="concave (membrane) face",color="#2166ac")
ax.bar(x+w/2,conv,w,label="convex face",color="#999999")
ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.8); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names)
ax.set_ylabel("mean screened-Coulomb potential\n6 A above surface (kcal/mol/e)")
ax.set_title("BAR concave-face electrostatics")
ax.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
